Source: the four existing public/demo-videos/*.mp4 files in this repository.
Captured 2026-10-22 using the actual local browser worker and Google MediaPipe
Pose Landmarker Full float16 version 1, tasks-vision 0.10.14, CPU delegate.
VIDEO mode maintains continuous tracks; implausible inverted tracks trigger
fresh detection, and their observations remain UNKNOWN.
Each video was decoded at 640x360; frames were sampled at 5 Hz. The same worker
used by the dashboard processed sequential frames; values rounded to five
coordinate decimals/four visibility decimals. 75 samples per video.
These are measured model outputs, not manually assigned labels or invented
skeletons. The JSON is used to reproduce classifier behavior without network,
GPU or camera dependencies. Python dependency download failed; extraction was
completed with the browser model instead.

The timestamp assertions document behavior on these particular clips only.
They are regression expectations, not runtime rules, clinical thresholds,
independent validation data, sensitivity, specificity or predictive accuracy.

live-fall-poses.json: Additional real-time Chrome playback measurements from the
same local worker on 2026-10-22. Captures brief occlusion/reacquisition during
descent; coordinates rounded to five decimals, visibility to four.
